alph1.explanation: θ vocātur “thēta”; sonat ut t aspīrātum, nōn ut Anglicum “th”.

alph2.prompt: Quō sonō pronūntiātur υ in Atticō reconstrūctō?
alph2.explanation: Υ Atticum est vōcālis anterior labializāta, sīcut Gallicum “u” vel Germānicum “ü”.

alph3.prompt: Quae litterae Graecae sunt SEMPER longae?
alph3.explanation: Η et ω semper vōcālēs longae sunt; ε et ο semper brevēs; α ι υ possunt esse utrumque.

alph4.prompt: Quōmodo sonat σ inter duās vōcālēs in Atticō Classicō?
alph4.explanation: Σ in Graecō Classicō semper est /s/ surdum.

alph5.prompt: Quid accidit litterae γ ante γ, κ, χ, vel ξ (ut in ἄγγελος)?
alph5.explanation: Ante hās litterās, γ assimilātur ad sonum nāsālem vēlārem “ng”.

alph6.explanation: Occlūsīvae aspīrātae (θ φ χ) differunt ab occlūsīvīs simplicibus (τ π κ) sonō aspīrātiōnis statim sequentis; ψ et ξ semper sunt coniūnctiōnēs duārum cōnsonantium.
alph6.exerciseInstructions: Iunge quamque litteram cum dēscrīptiōne phōneticā suā.

alph7.statement: Littera σ scrībitur ς cum est ultima littera verbī, sed sonus manet idem.
alph7.explanation: Corrēctum: sōla fōrma scrīptūrae mūtātur in fīne verbī, nōn sonus.
alph7.exerciseInstructions: Dēcerne utrum vērum an falsum sit.

alph8.statement: In pronūntiātiōne Atticā reconstrūctā, θ sonat ut Anglicum “th” in “think”.
alph8.explanation: Falsum: θ Atticum est occlūsīva aspīrāta (t+h), nōn fricātīva ut Anglicum “th”.
alph8.exerciseInstructions: Dēcerne utrum vērum an falsum sit.

alph9.statement: Alphabētum Graecum Classicum habet vīgintī quattuor litterās.
alph9.explanation: Corrēctum: XXIV litterae, post reformātiōnem Atticam annō 403 a.C. officiāliter adoptātam.
alph9.exerciseInstructions: Dēcerne utrum vērum an falsum sit.

alph10.statement: Vōcālēs ε et ο possunt esse aut brevēs aut longae, sīcut α.
alph10.explanation: Falsum: ε et ο sunt SEMPER brevēs; sōlum α, ι, υ possunt variāre longitūdine.
alph10.exerciseInstructions: Dēcerne utrum vērum an falsum sit.

art1.prompt: Quae est fōrma nōminātīva singulāris fēminīna articulī?
art1.explanation: Ἡ est fōrma fēminīna singulāris; ὁ masculīnum, τό neutrum.

art2.explanation: Graecum caret articulō indēfīnītō; nōmen sine articulō est fōrma normālis prō “a/an” Anglicō vel generāli.

art3.prompt: Quī numerī Graecī dēclīnantur per cāsūs?
art3.explanation: Sōlum 1, 2, et 3 dēclīnantur; numerī IV–X manent indēclīnābilēs.

art4.prompt: Quid est ι' in numerālibus alphabēticīs Graecīs?
art4.explanation: Ι (iōta) est decima littera alphabētī, ergō ι' = 10.

art5.prompt: Quae est fōrma plūrālis neutra articulī?
art5.explanation: Τά est nōminātīvus plūrālis neutrī; τό est fōrma singulāris.

art6.explanation: Ἄνθρωπος est masculīnum; articulus masculīnus singulāris est ὁ.
art6.exerciseInstructions: Comple spatia cum fōrmā rēctā articulī, secundum genus nōminis datī.

art7.explanation: Ἀλήθεια est fēminīnum; articulus fēminīnus singulāris est ἡ.
art7.exerciseInstructions: Comple spatia cum fōrmā rēctā articulī, secundum genus nōminis datī.

art8.explanation: Βιβλίον est neutrum; articulus neutrī singulāris est τό.
art8.exerciseInstructions: Comple spatia cum fōrmā rēctā articulī, secundum genus nōminis datī.

art11.statement: Graecum classicum habet articulum indēfīnītum sīcut Anglicum “a/an”.
art11.explanation: Falsum: Graecum caret omnīnō articulō indēfīnītō.
art11.exerciseInstructions: Dēcerne utrum vērum an falsum sit.

art12.statement: Articulus Graecus concordat cum nōmine suō in genere, numerō, et cāsū.
art12.explanation: Corrēctum: sīcut adiectīvum, articulus semper concordat cum suō nōmine.
art12.exerciseInstructions: Dēcerne utrum vērum an falsum sit.

art13.statement: Numerī Graecī IV–X (τέτταρες, πέντε...) dēclīnantur per cāsūs sīcut εἷς et δύο.
art13.explanation: Falsum: sōlum 1, 2, 3 dēclīnantur; reliquī sunt indēclīnābilēs.
art13.exerciseInstructions: Dēcerne utrum vērum an falsum sit.

art14.statement: Numerālia alphabētica Graeca requīrunt trēs litterās antīquās nōn iam in alphabētō classicō XXIV litterārum.
art14.explanation: Corrēctum: digamma/stigma (6), qoppa (90), sampi (900) sunt vestīgia alphabētī prīmōrdiālis.
art14.exerciseInstructions: Dēcerne utrum vērum an falsum sit.

cons1.prompt: Quōmodo sonat cōnsonāns gemināta (ut ππ) in Graecō?
options: ut duo sonī omnīnō sēparātī cum pausā
cons1.explanation: Geminātiō indicat longitūdinem sonī, nōn duōs sonōs sēparātōs neque nūllam differentiam.

cons2.explanation: Prīma γ ante alteram γ assimilātur ad sonum nāsālem vēlārem “ng”.

cons3.prompt: Quod verbum est fōrma Attica prō “mare”?
cons3.explanation: Ττ est fōrma Attica proprissima; σσ est fōrma commūnior in aliīs dialectīs et in Koinē.

cons4.prompt: Ante quās litterās γ assimilātur ad sonum nāsālem?
options: ante γ, κ, ξ, χ tantum
cons4.explanation: Assimilātiō nāsālis occurrit tantum ante alterās velārēs: γ, κ, ξ, χ.

cons5.prompt: Quid indicat σσ/ττ variātiō in verbīs sīcut θάλασσα/θάλαττα?
cons5.explanation: Est variātiō dialectālis rēalis, nōn error nec discrīmen significātiōnis.

cons6.explanation: Assimilātiō nāsālis sequitur locum articulātiōnis cōnsonantis sequentis; ττ/σσ sunt variātiō dialectālis, nōn assimilātiō.
cons6.exerciseInstructions: Iunge quodque digraphum nāsāle cum sonō suō.

cons7.statement: Cōnsonāns gemināta (ut λλ) sonat exāctē sīcut fōrma simplex (ut λ).
cons7.exerciseInstructions: Dēcerne utrum vērum an falsum sit.

cons8.statement: Γ ante κ (ut in ἄγκυρα) assimilātur ad sonum nāsālem “ng”.
cons8.explanation: Corrēctum: assimilātiō nāsālis occurrit ante omnem velārem (γ, κ, ξ, χ).
cons8.exerciseInstructions: Dēcerne utrum vērum an falsum sit.

cons9.statement: Θάλαττα et θάλασσα sunt duo verba dīversa cum significātiōnibus dīversīs.
cons9.explanation: Falsum: sunt variantēs dialectālēs (Attica/commūnis) ūnīus eiusdemque verbī, “mare”.
cons9.exerciseInstructions: Dēcerne utrum vērum an falsum sit.

cons10.statement: Assimilātiō nāsālis γ occurrit tantum ante vōcālēs.
cons10.explanation: Falsum: occurrit ante cōnsonantēs velārēs (γ, κ, ξ, χ), nōn ante vōcālēs.
cons10.exerciseInstructions: Dēcerne utrum vērum an falsum sit.

lec4.statement: Magister (διδάσκαλος) dēscrībitur ut sapiēns et amīcus.
lec4.explanation: Corrēctum: “Ὁ διδάσκαλος σοφός ἐστιν” et “καὶ φίλος ἐστιν”.
lec4.exerciseInstructions: Secundum dialogum, dēcerne utrum vērum an falsum sit.

lec5.explanation: Est fōrmula idiōmatica classica: datīvus prōnōminis + ὄνομα + ἐστίν + nōmen.

lec6.prompt: Cūr ὄνομα accipit accentum additum in “ὄνομά ἐστιν”?
options: quia sequitur enclītica ἐστίν, et ὄνομα est proparoxytonum
quia ὄνομα est semper sīc accentuātum
lec6.explanation: Verba proparoxytona (accentus in antepaenultimā) accipiunt accentum additum ante enclīticam.

lec7.prompt: Quid indicat signum · (pūnctum altum) in textū?
lec7.explanation: · (ānō teleíā) fungitur sīcut sēmicolon vel colon Latīnum, nōn ut pūnctum plēnum vel interrogātiōnem.

lec8.prompt: Quae est fōrma fēminīna vōcābulī μαθητής?
lec8.explanation: Μαθήτρια est fōrma fēminīna singulāris; μαθηταί est plūrālis masculīnus, μαθητῶν genetīvus plūrālis.

lec9.explanation: Omnēs hae phrasēs adhibent sōlum fōrmās et vocābula iam discita in Gradū I — hoc probat tē iam posse legere Graecum simplex continuum.
lec9.exerciseInstructions: Iunge quamque phrasim ex textū cum versiōne Latīnā suā.

pron1.prompt: Quae fōrma adhibētur semper post praepositiōnem?
pron1.explanation: Post praepositiōnem, fōrma fortis semper requīritur (πρὸς ἐμέ, nōn *πρὸς με).

pron2.explanation: Μοι est fōrma enclītica datīvī prōnōminis ἐγώ.

pron3.prompt: Quandō adhibētur fōrma fortis (ἐμοί) potius quam enclītica (μοι)?
pron3.explanation: Fōrma fortis marcat ēmphasim/contrāstum; enclītica est ūsus normālis, nōn-ēmphaticus.

pron4.prompt: Quae fōrma est genetīvus fortis prōnōminis σύ?
pron4.explanation: Σοῦ (cum accentū circumflexō) est fōrma fortis; σου (sine accentū proprio hīc) est enclītica.

pron5.prompt: Habet nōminātīvus prōnōminis persōnālis (ἐγώ, σύ) fōrmam encliticam?
pron5.explanation: Nōminātīvus numquam est enclīticus; sōlum cāsūs oblīquī habent duplicem sēriem.

pron6.explanation: Ūsus normālis, nōn-ēmphaticus: fōrma enclītica μοι.
pron6.exerciseInstructions: Comple spatia cum fōrmā rēctā prōnōminis, fortī an encliticā secundum contextum.

pron7.explanation: Post praepositiōnem πρός, fōrma fortis semper requīritur: ἐμέ.
pron7.exerciseInstructions: Comple spatia cum fōrmā rēctā prōnōminis, fortī an encliticā secundum contextum.

pron8.explanation: Contrāstus explicitus (οὐ σοί) requīrit fōrmam fortem: ἐμοί.
pron8.exerciseInstructions: Comple spatia cum fōrmā rēctā prōnōminis, fortī an encliticā secundum contextum.

pron9.explanation: Ūsus normālis, nōn-ēmphaticus, obiectum: fōrma enclītica με.
pron9.exerciseInstructions: Comple spatia cum fōrmā rēctā prōnōminis, fortī an encliticā secundum contextum.

pron10.explanation: Possessiō ēmphatica hīc favet fōrmam fortem ἐμοῦ (litt. “librum meī est”).
pron10.exerciseInstructions: Comple spatia cum fōrmā rēctā prōnōminis, fortī an encliticā secundum contextum.

pron11.statement: Fōrmae fortēs et encliticae prōnōminum persōnālium habent significātiōnēs omnīnō dīversās.
pron11.explanation: Falsum: referunt ad eundem cāsum eiusdemque prōnōminis; differunt in ūsū syntacticō/emphaticō, nōn in sēnsū fundāmentālī.

pron12.statement: Post praepositiōnem, fōrma enclītica prōnōminis est adhibenda.
pron12.explanation: Falsum: post praepositiōnem, fōrma fortis semper requīritur.
pron12.exerciseInstructions: Dēcerne utrum vērum an falsum sit.

pron13.statement: Ἐμοῦ, ἐμοί, ἐμέ sunt fōrmae fortēs cāsuum oblīquōrum prōnōminis ἐγώ.
pron13.explanation: Corrēctum: genetīvus, datīvus, accūsātīvus fortēs, respondentēs μου, μοι, με enclīticīs.

pron14.statement: Nōminātīvus prōnōminis persōnālis potest esse enclīticus, sī nōn ēmphaticus.
pron14.explanation: Falsum: nōminātīvus (ἐγώ, σύ) numquam habet fōrmam encliticam.
pron14.exerciseInstructions: Dēcerne utrum vērum an falsum sit.

eimi6.prompt: Quis cāsus post εἰμί semper adhibētur (ut praedicātum)?
eimi6.explanation: Praedicātum post εἰμί semper nōminātīvō pōnitur, sīcut post Latīnum ‘sum’.

options: ν additum fīnī ἐστί/εἰσί ante vōcālem vel pausam
eimi7.explanation: Est ν movēns additum ut hiātus vītētur et pausa signētur.

eimi8.prompt: Quōmodo dīcitur “who are you?” Graecē (cum signō interrogātiōnis rēctō)?

eimi9.explanation: χαίρετε est fōrma plūrālis salūtātiōnis χαῖρε.

eimi10.prompt: Cūr prōnōmen ἐγώ saepe omittitur ante εἰμί?
options: quia dēsinentia verbī iam persōnam indicat
quia εἰμί semper prīmam persōnam significat sine prōnōmine
eimi10.explanation: Verba Graeca, sīcut Latīna, persōnam in dēsinentiā portant; prōnōmen est optiōnāle, prō ēmphasī tantum.

eimi11.explanation: Salūtātiōnēs Graecae plērumque nōn sunt versiōnēs verbālēs Latīnārum, sed fōrmulae propriae cum sēnsū homologō.
eimi11.exerciseInstructions: Iunge quamque phrasim Graecam cum sēnsū Latīnō suō.

spir1.explanation: Spīritus asper indicat sonum /h/ pronuntiandum ante vōcālem vel diphthongum initiālem.

spir2.prompt: Super quam litteram diphthongī pōnitur spīritus (et accentus, sī adest)?
spir2.explanation: In diphthongō, signa (spīritus et accentus) super secundam vōcālem scrībuntur, ut in εἰμί vel αὐτός.

spir3.prompt: Quae littera initiālis SEMPER accipit spīritum asperum?
spir3.explanation: Omnis ρ initiālis verbī accipit spīritum asperum (ῥ), unde Latīnum “rhētor” in verbīs mūtuātīs.

options: in ūnā ex tribus ultimīs syllabīs
spir4.explanation: Accentus acūtus potest cadere in ultimā, paenultimā, vel antepaenultimā syllabā (ultimīs tribus).

options: parva iōta scrīpta sub α, η, vel ω longīs
spir5.explanation: Iōta subscrīptum (ᾳ ῃ ῳ) est parva iōta scrīpta sub vōcālī longā, vestīgium antīquae diphthongī.

sōlum super vōcālem longam, in ūnā ex duābus ultimīs syllabīs
parva ι sub α, η, vel ω longīs

spir6.explanation: Quodque signum habet fūnctiōnem propriam et locum ubi lēgitimē appārēre potest.
spir6.exerciseInstructions: Iunge quodque signum cum dēscrīptiōne suā.

spir7.statement: Omnis vōcālis initiālis verbī Graecī accipit vel spīritum lēnem vel spīritum asperum.
spir7.explanation: Corrēctum: nūlla vōcālis initiālis caret utrōque signō.
spir7.exerciseInstructions: Dēcerne utrum vērum an falsum sit.

spir8.statement: Spīritus asper est mēra optiō graphica sine effectū in prōnūntiātiōne.
spir8.explanation: Falsum: spīritus asper reāliter significat sonum /h/ in prōnūntiātiōne Atticā.
spir8.exerciseInstructions: Dēcerne utrum vērum an falsum sit.

spir9.statement: Accentus circumflexus potest cadere in antepaenultimā syllabā.
spir9.explanation: Falsum: circumflexus sōlum in ultimā vel paenultimā (duābus ultimīs) cadere potest, numquam in antepaenultimā.
spir9.exerciseInstructions: Dēcerne utrum vērum an falsum sit.

spir10.statement: Initiālis ρ verbī Graecī semper accipit spīritum asperum.
spir10.explanation: Corrēctum: omne ρ initiāle habet spīritum asperum (ῥ).
spir10.exerciseInstructions: Dēcerne utrum vērum an falsum sit.

options: verbum breve sine accentū proprio quod adhaeret ANTE verbum sequēns
syll1.explanation: Prōclītica (ut ὁ, εἰ, ὡς) caret accentū proprio et phōneticē “inclīnat” in verbum sequēns.

options: verbum quod semper prīmum stat in clausulā
verbum breve sine accentū proprio quod adhaeret POST verbum praecēdēns
syll2.explanation: Enclītica (ut μου, τε, ἐστί nōn-initiāle) “inclīnat” retrō in verbum praecēdēns.

options: quae vōcālem brevem sine complicātiōne continet
quae vōcālem longam (η, ω, ᾱῑῡ) aut diphthongum continet
quae ultima est in verbō, semper
syll3.explanation: Syllaba longa continet vōcālem longam vel diphthongum (aut fit longa positiōne per cōnsonantēs sequentēs).

syll4.prompt: Quōmodo dīviduntur digrapha nāsālia (γγ, γκ, γξ, γχ) in syllabās?
syll4.explanation: Digrapha nāsālia repraesentant duōs sonōs distīnctōs, ideōque semper dīviduntur.

syll5.explanation: Μοι est fōrma enclītica prōnōminis, sine accentū proprio, adhaerēns post λέγει.

syll6.explanation: Rēgulae syllabārum et status accentuālis (prōclīticus/enclīticus) sunt duo aspecta dīversa ratiōnis phōnologicae Graecae.
syll6.exerciseInstructions: Iunge quemque terminum cum exemplō suō.

syll7.statement: Prōclīticae carent accentū proprio quia rēgula ita statuit, nōn quia error scrībendī sit.
syll7.explanation: Corrēctum: absentia accentūs in prōclīticīs (ὁ, εἰ, ὡς...) est rēgula legitima.
syll7.exerciseInstructions: Dēcerne utrum vērum an falsum sit.

syll8.statement: Digrapha nāsālia (γγ, γκ) manent semper in ūnā eādemque syllabā.
syll8.explanation: Falsum: semper dīviduntur inter duās syllabās, quia repraesentant duōs sonōs distīnctōs.
syll8.exerciseInstructions: Dēcerne utrum vērum an falsum sit.

syll9.statement: Ἐστί/εἰσί sunt semper encliticae, in omnī positiōne clausulae.
syll9.explanation: Falsum: sunt encliticae sōlum cum nōn sunt prīmum verbum clausulae.
syll9.exerciseInstructions: Dēcerne utrum vērum an falsum sit.

syll10.statement: Syllaba quae continet diphthongum generātim tractātur ut longa.
syll10.explanation: Corrēctum: diphthongī generātim faciunt syllabam longam, cum exceptiōnibus rārīs quās gradūs posteriōrēs explicābunt.
syll10.exerciseInstructions: Dēcerne utrum vērum an falsum sit.

voc1.prompt: Quōmodo sonat ει in prōnūntiātiōne Atticā reconstrūctā?
options: ut ē + ι distīncta, glide inter eās
ut ē longum clausum, vōcālis simplex
voc1.explanation: Ει est “falsa diphthongus”: iam saeculō V a.C. sonābat ut vōcālis longa simplex, clausa.

voc2.prompt: Quod discrīmen sonī distinguit η ab ει?
voc2.explanation: Ambae sunt ē longum, sed η apertius, ει clausius — discrīmen apertūrae, nōn longitūdinis.

voc3.prompt: Quid significat trēma (¨) super ι vel υ (ϊ, ϋ)?
options: duās vōcālēs sēparārī in hiātū, nōn coniungī in diphthongō
voc3.explanation: Trēma indicat hiātum: duae vōcālēs manent in syllabīs sēparātīs.

voc4.prompt: Quae ex hīs est diphthongus vēra (nōn falsa)?
voc4.explanation: Αι manet diphthongus vēra per tōtum perīodum Classicum; ει et ου sunt falsae (mōnophthongātae).

voc5.explanation: Αυ sonat ut diphthongus vēra /au̯/, similis Anglicō “ow” in “how”.

voc6.explanation: Quīnque diphthongī sonant coniūnctim (vōcālis + vōcālis); ει et ου sōlae sunt “falsae”, id est vōcālēs longae simplicēs.
voc6.exerciseInstructions: Iunge quamque diphthongum cum dēscrīptiōne phōneticā suā.

voc7.statement: Ει et ου vocantur “diphthongī falsae” quia numquam vērē diphthongī fuērunt.
voc7.explanation: Falsum: ortū erant diphthongī vērae; mōnophthongātae sunt tantum posteā, ante perīodum Classicum iam completum.
voc7.exerciseInstructions: Dēcerne utrum vērum an falsum sit.

voc8.statement: Η et ει sonant exāctē idem in Atticō reconstrūctō.
voc8.explanation: Falsum: differunt apertūrā ōris, quamquam ambae sunt “ē” longum.
voc8.exerciseInstructions: Dēcerne utrum vērum an falsum sit.

voc9.statement: Trēma (¨) super ι vel υ indicat hiātum, nōn diphthongum.
voc9.explanation: Corrēctum: trēma explicitē sēparat duās vōcālēs in syllabās distīnctās.
